code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    upside_down = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        out.append(grid[r] + clockwise[r])
    for r in range(h):
        out.append(counterclockwise[r] + upside_down[r])
    return out
'''
